title: HDMI 2.1 Display Stream Compression (DSC) Ready for Amdgpu Linux Driver
summary: AMD's open-source AMDGPU Linux kernel driver has added preliminary support for HDMI 2.1 Display Stream Compression (DSC) with Fixed Rate Link (FRL), enabling higher bandwidth displays like 4K@120Hz and 8K monitors over HDMI connections on Linux systems.
problem_solved: Enables AMD GPU users on Linux to connect and drive high-resolution, high-refresh-rate displays (4K@120Hz, 8K) that exceed standard HDMI 2.0 bandwidth limitations.
why_valuable: Provides Linux desktop users with AMD graphics cards access to cutting-edge display capabilities previously only available on Windows or requiring DisplayPort connections.
